entries.summary: At a re-enable one frame after a disable, OpenModelica resets the PIDWithReset integrator (Change fires again) and the engine does not (Change held true on two consecutive frames is one rising edge).

subject.observation: t=382 s, enable false at 377 s and true at 382 s, TSup 290 K from 382 s

evidence.summary: The engine's valve signal over the probe frames, as bits: 0.036, 0.051 and 0.066 at 382, 387 and 392 s.
OpenModelica 1.25.1 running upstream CoolingCoilValve on the probe frames: reset at 382 s, then 0, 0.015 and 0.030.

entries.disposition: Resolved by the settled-value rule of issue #800 (https://github.com/jscott3201/open-control-engine/issues/800; design note docs/design/pulse-event-inputs.md, option (g)): Change(enable) is a primitive pulse, so PIDWithReset.trigger fires on every frame it is true and the engine resets at 382 s as OpenModelica does. The evidence files are kept as the record of the engine before the rule; building_33_openmodelica_reenable.rs now checks the agreement.

entries.summary: OnCounter fed by Change of a signal that changes on consecutive frames: OpenModelica counts every change, the engine one per run of consecutive changes.

subject.observation: u changes at 2, 3, 5, 7, 8 and 9 s at 1 s frames; counts part from 3 s

evidence.summary: The engine's count over the ten frames: 3, 3, 4, 4, 4, 5, 5, 6, 6, 6.

entries.disposition: Resolved by the settled-value rule of issue #800 (https://github.com/jscott3201/open-control-engine/issues/800; design note docs/design/pulse-event-inputs.md, option (g)): OnCounter counts every consecutive Change pulse, 3, 3, 4, 5, 5, 6, 6, 7, 8, 9 as OpenModelica does. The evidence files are kept as the record of the engine before the rule; open_modelica_event_pulses.rs now checks the agreement.

entries.summary: A cone with a Pre falls back to the rising edge: OnCounter behind Or(Change(u), Pre(b)) counts one event where OpenModelica counts three.

subject.observation: u changes at 2, 3, 5, 7, 8 and 9 s, b true on [2, 7) s, 1 s frames; counts part from 8 s

evidence.summary: OpenModelica 1.25.1 running the pinned Buildings classes: 3, 3, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 5, 6.

entries.disposition: Documented HostTick v1 limit, owner ruling 2 of 2026-11-22 on issue #800 (https://github.com/jscott3201/open-control-engine/issues/800; docs/design/pulse-event-inputs.md): a cone that reads a Pre keeps the rising edge (decision 5), because OpenModelica's Pre settles in the second event iteration of an instant and the engine's a frame later. Nothing is refused.

entries.summary: Several sample instants in one frame fire once: OnCounter behind SampleTrigger(0.5 s) at 1 s frames counts 10 where OpenModelica counts 19.

subject.observation: SampleTrigger(period = 0.5 s) from an instant at t = 0, 1 s frames

evidence.summary: OpenModelica 1.25.1 running the pinned Buildings classes: 1, 3, 5, ..., 19.

entries.disposition: Documented HostTick v1 limit, owner ruling 2 of 2026-11-22 on issue #800 (https://github.com/jscott3201/open-control-engine/issues/800; docs/design/pulse-event-inputs.md): the engine evaluates once per frame and shows every event of the frame interval at its end; a frame that spans several instants of a SampleTrigger fires once, and the block warns once (decision 2). The host obligation is a frame step at or below the sample period.

entries.summary: An instant between frames is shown at the next frame with that frame's values: TriggeredSampler behind SampleTrigger(1.4 s) at 1 s frames samples the frame's input, OpenModelica the input at the instant.

subject.observation: SampleTrigger(period = 1.4 s), instants at 0, 1.4, 2.8, ... s, 1 s frames, input held from half a frame before each frame

evidence.summary: OpenModelica 1.25.1 running the pinned Buildings classes: 2.5, 2.5, 3.5, 4.75, 4.75, -6.5, -9.25, 10.5, 10.5, -11.75.

entries.disposition: Documented HostTick v1 limit, owner ruling 2 of 2026-11-22 on issue #800 (https://github.com/jscott3201/open-control-engine/issues/800; docs/design/pulse-event-inputs.md): HostTick v1 snaps every event of the frame interval to the frame's time and evaluates it with the frame's inputs (section 6, snapping); the count of samples agrees, the sampled value is the frame's.

entries.summary: A cone with a Pre falls back to the rising edge: OnCounter behind Pre(SampleTrigger(1 s)) counts one event where OpenModelica counts one per instant.

subject.observation: SampleTrigger(period = 1 s), frames at 0.25 + k s, so the start is not an instant

evidence.summary: OpenModelica 1.25.1 running the pinned Buildings classes: 0, 1, 2, ..., 9.

entries.disposition: Documented HostTick v1 limit, owner ruling 2 of 2026-11-22 on issue #800 (https://github.com/jscott3201/open-control-engine/issues/800; docs/design/pulse-event-inputs.md): a cone that reads a Pre keeps the rising edge (decision 5); a sample true on every frame is one rising edge through it. Nothing is refused.
